messages:
elaine_pm: Quick sync — packaging change implementation: need clear owners for metering adapter, billing mapping, quota integration, and contract update. Target: feature-freeze 2026-04-15. Who takes what?

devin_eng: I can own the metering adapter and infra hooks. PR branch is feature/packaging-metering. Tests are green except for a rate-limit flake.

matt_billing: I can own billing mapping + ratecard changes. Need a canonical list of usage buckets (tokens vs embeddings vs rerank). @elaine_pm confirm final buckets?

elaine_pm: Use these buckets for now: gen_tokens, embed_units, rerank_calls. We'll lock them for the first rollout.

rachel_sales: I'll produce the list of customers impacted by the packaging flag (enterprise customers + anyone with custom contracts) — ETA EOD tomorrow.

sara_legal: For contract text I need the concrete language about quota enforcement and overage billing. Can someone paste the proposed clause?

matt_billing: Suggested clause snippet: "Customers are subject to configured quotas. Overages are billed at tiered rates according to the customer's rate plan; see billing_ratecard_v2."

sara_legal: Good start, will iterate. Need impacted contract IDs from @rachel_sales.

devin_eng: Metering adapter note: we need a stable quota token schema for the quotas team. Proposed JSON for quota token: ```json
{
  "quota_id": "string",
  "limit": 1000,
  "window_seconds": 3600,
  "tags": ["customer_id","bucket"]
}
```

anil_sre: Quotas/integration team ack. We'll run end-to-end tests on staging next week. Need the endpoint path and auth header name.

devin_eng: Endpoint: POST /v1/internal/quotas/check. Auth header: X-Quota-Key. Adding schema to the PR description.

oliver_reviewer: I can review PR 4023 (metering adapter) tomorrow AM. Please assign to me.

ci-bot: build passed for feature/packaging-metering (commit abc123) :white_check_mark:

matt_billing: Telemetry tags to add: pkg_change_v2, packaging_rollout, customer_segment. These will help billing reconciliation.

anil_sre: Also need a feature flag for gradual ramp: suggest feature: packaging_rollout_v2 with percentage rollout in config service. We'll wire traffic split in envoy.

devin_eng: Agreed. I'll add the flag and ensure adapter checks it before emitting new usage events.

elaine_pm: Owners summary for canary: metering -> devin_eng, billing mapping + docs -> matt_billing, quotas/integration -> anil_sre, contracts -> sara_legal, customer list -> rachel_sales, code review -> oliver_reviewer. Canary deploy to staging is scheduled 2026-04-10. Action items: 1) Rachel export customer list; 2) Oliver review PR; 3) Anil schedule integration tests; 4) Matt prepare billing docs and ratecard mapping; 5) Sara draft contract language.

rachel_sales: Noted — exporting list now, will push to the shared drive and tag @sara_legal.

oliver_reviewer: Assigned and will post review comments by EOD.

anil_sre: Scheduling integration window for 2026-04-09 02:00-05:00 UTC. Please freeze changes in the branch during that slot.

devin_eng: Will freeze branch and open a release candidate tag.

matt_billing: I'll draft billing mapping doc and include an example invoice line item for overage.

elaine_pm: One more: add a short rollback plan to the PR: toggle flag off + fallback to previous ratecard. Keep rollback under 10 minutes.

devin_eng: Will add rollback steps in the PR checklist.

elaine_pm: Thanks everyone — I'll update the JIRA ticket with owners/milestones and ping again Monday. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: deployment to staging scheduled for 2026-04-10 04:00 UTC (canary) — prechecks pending.
